providers.note: Privacy inventory (owner decisions 2026-10-11, consistent with consent version B): during a consented Web Speech session, the browser itself sends the microphone audio to its speech service to turn it into text (in Chrome, Google's speech service); this is not local or offline processing. JagaOn's page makes no request to that service (the browser does), receives only the text, and stores nothing until an explicit Save. English (en-SG) only.
